mapper.select: SELECT id, sn, project_id, project_assignment_version, customer_id, customer_assignment_version, tenant_id FROM ast_device WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.deviceId} AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, device_sn, project_id, relationship_type, effective_from, effective_to, assignment_version, reason, operation_id, source_system, source_key, source_version, version, tenant_id FROM ast_device_project_relationship WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND device_sn = ( SELECT sn FROM ast_device WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.deviceId} AND deleted = b'0' ) AND relationship_type = 'DIRECT' AND effective_to IS NULL AND deleted = b'0' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ast_device_project_relationship r JOIN ast_device d ON d.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND d.sn = r.device_sn SET r.effective_to = #{effectiveTo}, r.assignment_version = #{assignmentVersion} WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.id = #{deviceId} AND r.relationship_type = 'DIRECT' AND r.effective_to IS NULL AND r.deleted = b'0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast_device_project_relationship ( device_sn, project_id, relationship_type, effective_from, effective_to, assignment_version, reason, operation_id, source_system, source_key, source_version, version, tenant_id ) VALUES ( #{deviceSn}, #{projectId}, #{relationshipType}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{assignmentVersion}, #{reason}, #{operationId}, #{sourceSystem}, #{sourceKey}, #{sourceVersion}, #{version}, #{tenantId} )
